Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].cChildren AS 'AddCalculatedMembers([Store].currentmember.children).count' SET FilteredMembers AS 'Head(Filter(AddCalculatedMembers([Store].[Store City].Members), InStr(1, [Store].currentmember.member_caption, "an") > 0), 10001)' SELECT {[Measures].cChildren} ON ROWS, Hierarchize(Generate(FilteredMembers, Ascendants([Store].currentmember))) DIMENSION PROPERTIES PARENT_UNIQUE_NAME, MEMBER_TYPE ON COLUMNS FROM [ZFMSALES]
